protocol.task_proxy: compatible = at least one non-held-out observation on the exact query task; off-task = training observations exist only on other tasks; unknown = no training-task evidence
protocol.missing_accuracy: unknown; never treated as observed poor performance
protocol.labeled_ndcg: rank only observed candidates; per-query min-max accuracy relevance; linear gain
protocol.best_observed_regret: conditional on at least one observed top-k model; coverage reported separately

representative_sampling.method: three fixed-seed random queries per gold@10 outcome quadrant
